description: Operator-facing index of OAS runtime output and schema surfaces. Entries whose producer referenced the deleted Runtime_server / Runtime_sync / Runtime_projection / Runtime_evidence cluster (removed in v0.217.x) are marked removed_in; their schema files under docs/schemas/ are retained for historical decode only.

surfaces.validator: Typed OCaml payload variants and event catalog review
surfaces.notes: Native payloads stay provider-agnostic; downstream domain events should use Custom or a downstream bus.

Runtime protocol owns canonical request, response, event, report, proof, and system envelopes. Version 2 removes the implicit permission and hook control channel. Participant lifecycle events use one nested common participant record with disjoint live, completed, and failed payloads; legacy flat payloads are rejected. The Runtime_server subprocess that emitted these messages was removed in v0.217.x; the type truth in lib/runtime.mli is retained.
Schema file retained for historical decode of on-disk payloads. No shipped code produces or validates new runtime sync windows.

surfaces.wire_or_artifact: Runtime.report JSON artifact and Report_response payload
surfaces.notes: Runtime.report type retained in lib/runtime.mli. The projection builder (Runtime_projection.build_report) was removed in v0.217.x; no shipped code writes new report.json artifacts.

surfaces.wire_or_artifact: Runtime.proof JSON artifact and Prove_response payload
surfaces.notes: Runtime.proof type retained in lib/runtime.mli. The projection builder (Runtime_projection.build_proof) was removed in v0.217.x; no shipped code writes new proof.json artifacts.

surfaces.wire_or_artifact: runtime-telemetry-json artifact and structured telemetry reader payload
surfaces.notes: structured telemetry type truth (lib/sessions_types.mli) is retained. The telemetry report builder (Runtime_evidence.build_telemetry_report) was removed in v0.217.x; no shipped code writes new telemetry-report artifacts.
No shipped code produces new runtime evidence bundles. Sessions_types readers that consumed the bundle are retained.
Records run, assistant block, tool execution, hook, and terminal trace events. Raw_trace remains live via Runtime_store.

surfaces.producer: removed in v0.217.x (was Runtime_evidence; Raw_trace rows still written via Runtime_store)
surfaces.validator: Sessions.raw_trace_manifest_of_yojson plus raw trace run validation
surfaces.notes: Raw trace rows remain live via Runtime_store, but the manifest writer (Runtime_evidence.build_raw_trace_manifest) was removed in v0.217.x. Sessions.raw_trace_manifest_of_yojson reader is retained for historical decode.
JsonSchema response_format is the only schema request path; caller-side parse remains authoritative.
